verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows that the AI assistant can 'check your calendar' and 'write drafts'. That is an adjacent capability. There is no documented feature for sharing availability or inserting bookable meeting times or scheduling links into an email.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can share my availability or insert bookable meeting times directly into an email

citations.quote: it can read threads, write drafts, search your entire email history, check your calendar, and more.
